notes.title: Game Release!
notes.content:
After 2 years of work Septic is finally out!
Please play it and leave a review letting me know your thoughts.

notes.title: Septic Demo Releasing
notes.content:
A demo for [b]Septic [/b] will be releasing on February 13th for Steam Next Fest. Try it out and let me know what you think on the games community forum!

Thank you!
Bye!
